title: GitHub CLI Image and Video Viewing Support
body:
**Bug Description**
AI can view github issues using via github cli, however, it can't view the images / videos attached. This will be a great feature to have.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: kitty
- Version: 0.2.27
- Feedback ID: 457c2188-2c14-462b-927c-675c0536eeea
author: Stewart86
